subject: Running bootstrapping and generating P values

messages.author: 2fe8ab21f32e5a39
messages.subject: Running bootstrapping and generating P values
parts:
Dear Lavaan team,

Are you aware if p values are able to be generated from a bootstrapped dataset? I've tried to use the bootstrapLavaan() function, but it could only generate confidence intervals.

Sincerely,
Joe T

messages.author: ff3a366aa7a9b488
messages.subject: Re: Running bootstrapping and generating P values
parts: If you use se = "bootstrap" of the cfa or sem function, you can get p-values based on the bootstrap se. You have a few additional options here: https://groups.google.com/g/lavaan/c/0RSsh4M6zQg/m/BcbIDT5GBgAJ
